The '''Marleyvane system''' was a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="Triellus" /> which connected it to the [[Dennogra system/Legends|Dennogra]] and [[Junkfort system]]s. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Marleyvane [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained a Class IB [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], the output of which was limited to [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Marleyvane is intended as a check on Mon Cal Space, plus I liked the idea of a Dickensian name for a posting way out in the middle of the lawless Outer Rim.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Fry Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>}}
The Marleyvane system was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Fry later commented that the name "Marleyvane," which to him evoked<ref name="Fry Tumblr" /> the writings of [[Wikipedia:Charles Dickens|Charles Dickens]],<ref name="Dickensian">{{WebCite|url=http://www.oxforddictionaries.com/definition/english/Dickensian|text=DICKENSIAN &#124; Meaning & Definition for UK English|work=[[Wikipedia:Lexico|Lexico]]|archivedate=20140126014426}}</ref> seemed appropriate for an Imperial posting in a "lawless" area of the Outer Rim Territories. In addition, the author noted that the Imperial shipyard in the system was intended to serve as a check on [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]],<ref name="Fry Tumblr" /> a nearby region of independent, anti-Imperial [[Mon Calamari/Legends|shipbuilders]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Marleyvane system in grid square T-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
